stage: development; all previous validation labels exposed
ground_rule: one common S0 per molecule and parent, CAS(2,2) in canonical HOMO/LUMO of retained ground
excited_rule: retained rank-one OO pair, frozen orbitals, singlet CAS(2,2) closure from same functional
root_rule: among roots 1 and 2 choose maximum open-singlet weight; qualified if weight > 0.5 and margin against all other roots > 0.05
rank_gt_one: outside this bounded diagnostic; retained in cohort accounting
reuse: all completed references, calibrated responses, stationary grounds and excited checkpoints
